description: Third additive half-online task set, abstracted from PR #80-#101 real-use feedback WITHOUT copying user phrasing. Task IDs use N10-N16 and deliberately do NOT collide with the existing N1-N9 (tasks-online-gap.json) or J1-J6 (tasks-online-gap-2.json). It does NOT modify any existing task set, src/, scripts/, tests/, README or workflows. Every task is fake/replay only: dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no network, no real credentials, no real writes; requestIds stay unknown and are never fabricated. These tasks model the ONLINE-ONLY gap classes (G3/G5/G6) that the 2026-11-23 N/J sets did not cover, plus the write-path contracts surfaced by the newer feedback. No commit/push/deploy.

numbering.rule: No id reuse; if a gap is already covered by N1-N9/J1-J6, reference it rather than renumber.

tasks.name: issue-create-idempotency-and-number
tasks.gapClass: G3 online-only: create-then-read postcondition with idempotency and canonical number
tasks.prompt: Abstracted gap: a creation call whose returned identifier is unreliable must be re-derived from a canonical source, and a retried create must not produce duplicates. With a fake upstream, create once using a stable key, simulate a transient empty identifier on read-back, and assert tool-level truth: exactly one issue exists, number is URL-derived, id stays string-only, and the empty value is never surfaced as success. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.
preconditions: fake create/get with idempotency + delayed index
no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: ts-presubmit-and-patch-edit
tasks.gapClass: G3 online-only: pre-write syntax validation and first-class patch edits
tasks.prompt: Abstracted gap: malformed edits should be rejected before a write, and small changes should be expressible as unique-hit patches rather than whole-file replacement. With a fake upstream, present one syntactically invalid file and one valid patch edit. Assert: syntax precheck returns a structured path+line error and blocks the push with zero bytes written; the valid patch requires exactly one hit per oldText and commits atomically with a byte-equal readback. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.
preconditions: no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: truncation-advisory-separation
tasks.gapClass: G5 incomparable-metric misuse: advisory truncation suspect must not become a verdict
tasks.prompt: Abstracted gap: an advisory 'silent truncation' signal from a passive scorecard must not be promoted to a gateway fact or used as a pass/fail input. With a fake oversized body whose tail holds a key field, assert tool-level truth: structured truncation metadata is present and the tail field is accounted for, and a simulated advisory-suspect flag (0 or 9) does not change the boolean verdict. A truncated read is a hard stop before any write. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.
tasks.source: matrix FB7; scorecard-2026-11-23.md advisory policy; ONLINE-FEEDBACK-2026-11-24-PR80-101.md F4
preconditions: oversized fake body + advisory flag injection

tasks.name: ci-wait-and-rerun-helper
tasks.gapClass: G3 online-only: single-wait to terminal and failed-job rerun
tasks.prompt: Abstracted gap: CI observation should not require repeated manual polling, and a failed job should be rerunnable in one action. With a fake pending->completed status sequence and one failed job, assert: ciWaitRounds === 1 to terminal, one rerun dispatch for the failed job with a new run id, no token forwarded on a 302 log URL, and oversized logs flagged truncated. If neither helper exists in the checkout, record unknown/missing-capability with searched names — never a pass or gateway failure. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.
tasks.source: matrix FB8; complements J6 (which only covered wait)
tasks.skipReason: If no wait/rerun helper exists in checkout, record unknown/missing-capability; not a deploy-blocked item.
preconditions: fake CI status sequence + failed job + log fixture
no real token, no network, no real CI run

tasks.name: delete-rename-atomic-commit
tasks.gapClass: G3 online-only: delete+add (rename) as one atomic commit
tasks.prompt: Abstracted gap: a rename expressed as delete+add must not leave a two-commit half state. With a fake upstream, submit delete+add operations in one multi-file call and assert a single commit sha; inject a mid-operation failure and assert zero bytes written plus partial/written/remaining/compensation metadata. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.
preconditions: no real token, no network, no real write

tasks.name: branch-cleanup-after-merge
tasks.gapClass: G3 online-only: post-merge source-branch deletion as an explicit, guarded step
tasks.prompt: Abstracted gap: after a successful merge, source-branch cleanup should be an explicit guarded action, not an implicit manual follow-up. With a fake upstream, merge using a canonical PR number and assert the source branch is deleted exactly once on success and zero times on failure; the deleted ref comes from the canonical PR head, not an internal id. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false.
preconditions: no real token, no network, no real merge/delete

tasks.name: feedback-evidence-chain
tasks.gapClass: G6 evidence chain + G5 denominator: link a feedback item to task/request without fabricating ids
tasks.prompt: Abstracted gap: feedback and a passive scorecard must be joinable to a task without inventing identifiers or treating a known per-execution cap as a data bug. With fake evidence, assert: (a) a feedback record with no requestId stays 'unknown' and is never assigned a fabricated UUID; (b) the ~20 per-turn tool-call observation is recorded as a known execution cap, not an R2 list/denominator bug; (c) advisory model-truncation suspects are labeled advisory and excluded from pass/fail; (d) same-task/same-build pairing is used and cross-build hard comparison is forbidden. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no network.
tasks.source: matrix G5/G6 rows; ONLINE-FEEDBACK-2026-11-24-PR80-101.md section 1/4; GEMINI-PROBE.md 20-cap observation
